title: Reading: Father's Day
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 Exam Practice 3 (Ms. Clara), Reading Part 3 (with model answers)

scenes.t: Father's Day is a special day to celebrate dads. On this day, we show love and care for our fathers.
Many people give gifts or presents to their dads. A hug and a smile can make fathers very happy.
Some families prepare a special meal for their father. Others spend the whole day together doing fun activities.
My dad always supports me in everything I do. He has given me great advice throughout my life.
I remember many times when he helped me with my homework. His support makes me feel confident and strong.
You can write a card or give a simple gift. The most important thing is to show your love.

items.q: What can make fathers very happy on Father's Day?
How does the author feel when supported by their dad?
How can you celebrate Father's Day if you do not have much time?
o: Write a card or give a simple gift

items.q: What is the main purpose of celebrating Father's Day?
What does sharing fun moments create?
